picks.excerpt: UAD's free Luna DAW hits 3.0 with Luna Play for fast idea sketching, a proper piano roll and better MIDI editing. New smart features add automatic instrument detection, tempo recognition, stem separation, lyric transcription, chord extraction and audio-to-MIDI.
picks.rationale: A free DAW gaining a real piano roll plus stem separation, chord extraction and audio-to-MIDI changes what a bedroom producer can do tomorrow at zero cost.

picks.excerpt: MOTU's Digital Performer 12 lands with deep Dolby Atmos support, an Arrangement Strip and AI-powered stem separation, modernising a long-running Mac and Windows DAW.
picks.rationale: A major-version DAW release that finally puts Atmos authoring and stem separation inside Digital Performer — a concrete platform decision for mix and post rooms.

picks.excerpt: Antares AutoTune Go arrives inside FL Studio through the free tier of FL Cloud, putting the industry-standard pitch-correction sound in front of every FL user at no cost.
picks.rationale: The default pitch-correction sound becomes free inside the most widely used beat-making DAW — an immediate change to every FL vocal chain.

picks.excerpt: Dreamtonics' Instrument X swaps samples for neural synthesis to model orchestral instruments in real time. Production Expert tests what that means for template size, CPU load and sound.
picks.rationale: Neural synthesis instead of sample libraries rewrites the economics of an orchestral template — disk, RAM and CPU — and this is a hands-on listen, not a press release.

picks.excerpt: Roland released Melody Flip, a free AI-assisted songwriting plugin built with Sony Computer Science Laboratories. It generates melody variations from 250+ genre 'Palettes' and can analyse a reference track to suggest matching palettes, exporting ideas as MIDI.
picks.rationale: A free Roland x Sony CSL plugin that turns a reference track into usable melodic MIDI variations — songwriting assistance you can drop into any session today.
